A Bangladeshi prosecutor who had secured the death sentence against former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina says she will be executed if she returns home. Hasina, whose 15-year rule, was ended by a mass uprising has vowed to return in December to Bangladesh/ Hem Saroya explains on Vantage.
